transcript: Speaker A: Dubai ki salary, ghar ke liye naya makaan, maa ke chehre ki muskaan. Sab ek cheez pe ruka tha, English. [Dubai salary, a new house, mother's smile. Everything was stuck on one thing, English.] ... Maine sab kuch kiya par English bolne ki baari aati hai to zubaan atak jaati hai. [I did everything but when it comes to speaking English, I freeze.] ... Phir maine English Seekho app download kiya. Isme AI coach Disha ke saath roz 15 minutes practice ki. [Then I downloaded English Seekho app. Practiced 15 minutes daily with AI coach Disha.] ... 3 mahine baad interview clear kiya aur aaj main Dubai mein hoon. [Cleared the interview after 3 months and today I am in Dubai.] ... Aap bhi ₹1 ke trial se start karo. [You too start with a ₹1 trial.]

summary: A hardware store helper dreams of working in Dubai but gets rejected in interviews because he freezes when speaking English. He downloads the English Seekho app, practices daily with AI coach Disha, and successfully clears his next interview. The ad ends with a call to action to download the app and start a trial for just ₹1.
